The more skill points you invest into any given aspect, the more modification points will become available for it. These points can be used to modify an aspect's combat arts.

The glowing circle around opponents indicates their level in relation to your hero. Examples:
 
Gray circle: that opponent is considerably weaker and will not yield much experience.
 
Red circle: That opponent's level is higher than your hero's.
